or 110-200 (230-330) |id = 4144 }} [[Aberrant spectre]]s can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] at level 60 [[Slayer]] and level 65 [[Combat level|combat]] by various [[Slayer masters]]. They can be found in the [[Stronghold Slayer Cave]], the second floor of the [[Slayer Tower]], and in [[Deepfin Mine]]. A [[nose peg]] or [[Slayer helmet]] is required when fighting aberrant spectres. Without either of those equipped, they will use a special attack which hits through protection prayers and drain the player's stats very quickly. Aberrant spectres have a normal magic attack that has a max hit of 8. [[Protect from Magic]] will completely neutralize it. With [[Bigger and badder]] unlocked, the [[Superior slayer monster|Superior]] variation, the [[Abhorrent spectre]] may spawn. The Abhorrent has a max hit of 33, and Protect from Magic will still prevent its normal damage. Players assigned aberrant spectres may also choose to kill [[Deviant spectre]]s in the [[Catacombs of Kourend]]. Deviant spectres are generally not preferred as they have have significantly higher defence, which yields lower Slayer experience rates while also having only marginally better drops. They do have access to the Catacombs droptable which includes pieces of the [[Dark totem]], and also have their own superior variant, the [[Repugnant spectre]], which will always drop a piece of the Dark totem. Deviant and Repugnant spectres share the requirement of a nose peg or Slayer helmet and Protect from Magic will negate all their damage. Directly east of the {{fairycode|djr}} [[fairy ring]], there is a mysterious hole for quick access to deviant spectres (it must have been accessed earlier from below - ‘Climb-up Vine’ - if not, there is a boulder instead of a hole). The closest bank to this location is the [[Shayzien]] bank, which is south-east of the mysterious hole. As [[Undead (attribute)|Undead]] monsters, the [[Salve amulet(ei)]] and its appropriate variations give a bonus to damage and accuracy against Aberrant spectres. However, this effect does not stack with the Slayer helmet. Since its 20% boost to all three combat styles is higher than the Slayer helmet's maximum of 16.67%, the amulet is generally preferred. Aberrant spectres are a popular task for their very frequent herb drops. They have an over 60% chance to drop at least one herb and may drop up to three, so bringing a [[herb sack]] is highly recommended. They also commonly drop seeds, so a [[Seed box]] is also helpful. Beyond that, they have a few alchable drops. A [[Cannon]] can be used in the Stronghold Slayer Cave and the Deepfin Mine, although these are not [[Multicombat area|Multicombat areas]] and will require safespotting to cannon more than one at a time. Aberrant spectres killed in the Slayer Tower benefit from the experience bonus granted by completing tiers of the [[Morytania Diary]]. The Stronghold Slayer cave is near multiple teleportation methods, has [[Nieve]] or [[Steve]] directly outside, and has a bank very close. A bank chest can be built in a hotspot within the Deepfin Mine and accessed quickly via a [[Shortcuts|shortcut]] requiring 84 [[Agility]]. Aberrant spectres also have the [[Spectral]] attribute, so the [[Ectoplasmator]] can be carried to yield a small amount of [[Prayer]] experience with each kill. ==Slayer Unlocks== {{Main|Slayer reward torch. |} ==Safespots== ===Deviant spectres=== Deviant spectres in the [[Catacombs of Kourend]] can be safespotted by standing south of the arch, south of the steel dragons and shades, then attacking across the water; or you can draw them along the side onto an invisible tile and range them from beyond their attack range. The latter spot also offers a backup position, in case the spectre walks beyond the 'stuck spot': you can retreat to the most south-western tile in front of the arch, adjacent to the water. In this position, the spectre will wander some tiles forward and become stuck in a second safespot. Without protection, a [[restore potion]] or [[magic potion]] can be used if accidentally dragged into their attack range as it significantly drains combat stats and can prevent teleporting out of the catacombs. Although you could bring an additional item based teleport as a compensating control (e.g., royal seed pod, teleport tablets, etc.) Another option is to attack the deviant spectres isolated on the far island using the backup safespot. Carrying telegrab runes is useful for those wishing to obtain any loot. Bringing high alchemy runes can also help extend trips here. File:Deviant spectre (Catacombs of Kourend) safespot.png|Safespot 1 in the [[Catacombs of Kourend]]. File:Deviant spectre (Catacombs of Kourend) safespot (2).png|Safespot 2 if you need to retreat ===Aberrant spectres=== Many safespots exist for aberrant spectres as well: * '''[[Slayer Tower]]''' — pull Spectres from the room south of the level 61 [[Agility]] shortcut toward the suit of armour and pile of bricks on the corner of the wall, then stand on the pile of bricks north-west of the shortcut. Players may wait out the aggression timer either by standing next to the table north-west of the stairs up to the next floor or, with 61 Agility, by the chain on the {{Floor|uk=0}}. The latter is completely safe as the [[Crawling Hand]]s are not aggressive. * '''[[Stronghold Slayer Cave]]''' — various safespots, but most will require waiting out the aggression timer. * '''[[Deepfin Mine]]''' — it is possible to attack the Spectres from near the easternmost torch around the nickel rocks. This safespot requires no setup. Safespots only work with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]], since there must be at least six tiles between the player and an Aberrant Spectre in order to outrange it. See the gallery below for screenshots and tile markers. '''''Note:''' It is possible to use a [[dwarf multicannon]] inside the Stronghold Slayer Cave. This is the recommended method for fastest Slayer experience.'' {{Tile markers box|Module:Tile markers/Aberrant spectres.json|showpreview=false}} File:Aberrant spectre (Slayer Tower) safespot.png|[[Slayer Tower]] — first safespot.
